reviews.t: This watch is by far the very best deal I've ever gotten
reviews.x: To be honest here this is my very first review that I've written here on Amazon. I have bought hundreds of items off Amazon. This watch is by far the very best deal I've ever gotten. For the money there is absolutely no way to match or beat the quality of this watch. I would have easily spent $300 for a timepiece this nice. This was an excellent buy!  Toby Moore

reviews.x: WOW! Where to start? I own lots of watches. Mechanical, electric and digital watches costing from $8 to $8000. This is one of the most impressive watches I've ever owned at ANY price. The quality is first rate and the specs are almost unbelievable. Finding a good automatic/mechanical diver is very easy and you can take your pick from numerous makes and model but, finding a really good, attractive quartz diver is a little tougher. I was worried about quality, which is why I bought from Amazon for easy returns.  A month in, couldn't be happier.  Has to be real sapphire glass because I've accidentally banged it a few times and it still looks brand new.  That alone makes this a great deal.  But it also keeps accurate time and looks great.  I'm not a fan of the little magnifying window for the date, but I won't take a star away for that!  Had a few comments how this looks like a similar watch that costs 3-5x this one!

Extremely well made. Attention to detail “almost” flawless. The date magnifier is oh so slightly not centered. It is as elegant as a quartz movement gets (the movement is swiss). I’d buy it again in a hearbeat. For the price you can’t beat it with a stick. The most important part...  it hasn’t gained or lost a second in the past week.

reviews.t: This is my second Phoibos watch, love it!
reviews.x: I have the last gen black (same watch but says PHOIBOS under the 12 mark instead of the octopus) face. I whore that watch every single day, work, play, yardwork, sailing, swimming, everything. It's such a great and comfortable watch. I ordered the blue one just to change things up. Much cooler with the new octopus logo, and quality is remarkable for this price point. Unbelievable actually. I'm very happy with my purchase. "Then why the 4 star?" you may ask. The band on this one (maybe just mine)

It Glows! I can make out the time in the earl dawn hours without too much of a problem. Good time keeping. You can tell the nice sapphire crystal really keeps the watch clear and scratch free. I love the octopus on all four areas of the watch, but decided to add a leather band to keep the stainlesss bracelet in good shape. I bought 2, one black for the Bond look and the blue one was just beautiful, couldn't resist. Both keep great time.

reviews.t: ... watch for about a week now and am very pleased. It looks great and keeps excellent time
reviews.x: I have had the watch for about a week now and am very pleased.  It looks great and keeps excellent time. This is the best $100 watch I have ever seen. The size is perfect for most wrist and I will probably buy another soon.

reviews.x: I looked on here for a submariner clone. Everything was either really cheap and you know you aren't going to get much then, or more expensive than I wanted to pay.  This watch had the looks and the specs that really caught my eye. Still I debated purchasing. I thought yeah it looks nice (like the Octopus logo) and could fool a few at first glance that it's a Rolex, but in the  end is it going to be any good? Will it last?  The first thing I noticed (besides it being totally covered in plastic ev

It took a few days but here I go... I actually bought two - the black faced one initially and then the blue faced once a week later. I have since fell in love with the blue face since it is really unique and really beautiful. Outside of this cosmetic difference what really excites me the most about this watch is: 1) 316L Stainless Steel case, 2) Ronda Swiss Movement, 3) Solid Stainless Steel wristband, 4) Sapphire Crystal all for $120.  I have owned, Seiko, Orient, and even Tag Heuer. The Phoibo

I've had this watch for a couple of weeks now.  Has a bit of heft and feels good in the hand and on the wrist.  Quality is surprisingly good, especially considering the price point.  Quartz accuracy as expected.  Watch case and bracelet nicely finished with contrasting brushed/polished surfaces.  Sapphire crystal is a bonus for the $$.  Lume is still a little weak, but adequate.  So pleased with this watch that I purchased a second one in black.  Kind of a no-brainer buy.
The second hand does not line up properly with the seconds on the right  half side of the watch. Also, the crown disengages and the watch stops. I do not recommend.

Practically read all the reviews and watched 4 YouTube reviews before buying this model. Every good thing you'll read about this watch is true: the components and bracelet are what you'd find in $300+ watches. What you'll read about the bad is true too unfortunately. The seconds hand doesn't line up with the mark in certain spots and the cyclops doesn't square up with the date window on mine. These details I overlooked because everything else makes up for it. reviews.t: Nice watch for the money but awful Lume.
reviews.x: Solid watch for the money but the lume is TERRIBLE. The product description said the loom was upgraded to superluminova but I don't believe that for a second. I'm not going to bother saying it back over that issue because overall it's still a great value.

This watch is beautiful.  The quality is better than $300+ watches.  The band alone is worth $100! and boy does it have some nice weight to it, which I like.  Feels good on the wrist.  Cannot recommend this watch enough.
probably more of my watches are autos but i like the grab and go of quartz--no fuss and easy to read.  i don't care whether they sweep or jump--just give me the time in a nice package...
Frayed, worn inner box. No plastic crown guard, watch running. Second hand hits between minute markers. Sloppy plastic wrap job around watch.
This is a really great dive watch, well made. Much better then I expected! Looks fantastic, you will love this watch.

reviews.t: High end features on an affordable watch.
reviews.x: The Invicta pro diver has a reputation for being the best most affordable submariner homage watch on the market. This one might be better. Assuming you are ok with a quartz movement. It has a better bracelet than the Invicta with solid end links. It has a ceramic bezel, a sapphire crystal, and the logo is really cool. claims.text: Reviewers widely consider the watch an outstanding value for its price, often comparing it favorably to far more expensive watches.
Many praise the build quality, specs, and materials such as the sapphire crystal and Swiss movement.
Several reviewers report accurate timekeeping and good lume.
A few reviewers report quality-control or condition issues, including misalignment, a disengaging crown, and a scratched/used-looking unit.
Some note minor cosmetic imperfections like a slightly off-center date magnifier.
